HAPPY 50TH BIRTHDAY FROM
SOMEONE WITH STANDARDS

inside_left.text:
Tonight's Special Guest

Buster

The Late Late Dog Show

beats.text: Tonight on the Late Late Dog Show... Buster!
Welcome back! Tonight's special guest — fresh from destroying the couch — it's Buster!
So, Buster, tell us about James.
James? Oh, where do I even start.
Apparently it's your 50th birthday. Huge achievement. You've survived another year despite needing me to supervise literally every meal.
James supports Arsenal and talks about them constantly. But sure, you're doing great.
Let me tell you about he thinks he is good at golf. Actually, no — the audience isn't ready.
he falls asleep on the sofa every evening. I'd intervene, but honestly it's more entertaining to watch.
And don't get me started on he claims Buster loves him most even though Sophie feeds him. The whole neighbourhood knows.
he still talks about his university days. I've reported this to the authorities. Multiple times.
But honestly, James... you do give excellent treats. And your lap is... adequate.
Everybody — Buster has spoken! Give it up for Buster!
Happy 50th Dad. Love Sophie and Buster.
